basics.name: Kody Deda
basics.label: iOS Developer
basics.summary: Senior iOS Developer with 5+ years of experience building polished, user-facing features for iPhone and iPad apps. Skilled in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM, and The Composable Architecture (TCA).

work.name: ForesightCares
highlights: Led iOS development at a healthcare startup, building two iPad apps (admin and patient-facing) end-to-end in SwiftUI and The Composable Architecture.
Architected a modular codebase of 60+ Swift packages and 150+ modules with Swift Package Manager for fast incremental builds, isolated testing, and cross-app code sharing.
Built a testable, dependency-injected data layer over an AWS AppSync (GraphQL) backend.
Implemented subscription billing with RevenueCat (onboarding, paywall, and upgrade flows) and integrated Amplitude for product analytics.
Created a reusable design system optimized for older adults, with large-scale typography and accessible components.
Integrated the company's internal AI camera feature into the app, owning the client-side integration and data flow.

work.name: PocketRadar
highlights: Shipped features for the companion app to a Bluetooth baseball radar, spanning player management, speed tracking, and onboarding, in SwiftUI, UIKit, and MVVM.
Built video playback with real-time speed overlays using AVFoundation, packaged as a reusable internal Swift package for camera and video.
Built a scalable REST API layer with multi-environment support to manage player data.
Implemented a local SQLite persistence layer with GRDB, built for SwiftUI previews and unit testing.
Centralized camera, microphone, Bluetooth, and photo-library permissions behind a single manager.

work.name: Dealerware
highlights: Developed user-facing features for an automotive iPhone app using UIKit and MVC.
Helped write bug fixes and analyze crash reports as well as diagnose issues in the app.
Actively participated in Agile development: sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and code reviews.
Managed sprint tracking and documentation using JIRA, Confluence, Slack, Github and other tools.
Utilized CI/CD pipelines with GitHub, Fastlane, and CircleCI to automate builds and streamline delivery.
